children: US defense IT integrator's fiscal Q2 revenue rose 6%, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS and adjusted EBITDA for fiscal Q2 beat analyst expectations
Company raised fiscal 2027 guidance for revenue, adjusted EBITDA, margin, and adjusted EPS
SAIC raises FY27 revenue guidance to $7.2 bln-$7.3 bln from $7.0 bln-$7.2 bln
Company now sees FY27 adjusted diluted EPS at $10.65-$10.75, up from $9.90-$10.10
SAIC reiterates FY27 free cash flow guidance of over $600 mln

CONTRACT VOLUME AND ACQUISITION - Revenue growth was driven by ramp up in volume on existing and new contracts and $20 mln contribution from SilverEdge acquisition, partially offset by contract completions
IMPROVED CONTRACT PROFITABILITY - Operating income margin increased due to improved profitability across contract portfolio and lower costs related to federal tax audits in prior year
HIGHER SG&A EXPENSES - Adjusted EBITDA margin declined due to higher selling, general and administrative expenses, including recovery of costs from patent settlement in prior year
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", 8 "hold" and 1 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the it services & consulting peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Science Applications International Corp is $125.00, about 0.8% below its August 28 closing price of $125.96
The stock recently traded at 12 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 10 three months ago
